body: A self-hosted chat interface for multiple AI model providers with agents, tool integrations, and multi-user access.
plain_description: **Bring conversations with major AI providers into one self-hosted chat platform.** Create AI assistants, search conversations, and work with files, images, and code. Manage users and access through a browser-based admin panel.
technical_description: LibreChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI chat platform with a browser-based interface for connecting to multiple AI providers. It supports agents, MCP tools, code execution, image generation, file interactions, conversation search, and multi-user authentication. It can run locally or in the cloud.
title: LibreChat
